title: The Best Prime Day Deals on Phone Accessories Won't Last After Tonight
gist: A WIRED affiliate roundup of Prime Day phone-accessory deals, including power banks, Qi2 chargers, cables and trackers. It notes that electronics prices have risen across the board and that deals are weaker than in the past.

insights.claim: WIRED's research finds electronics prices have gone up across the board and Prime Day deals are not as good as in previous years.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Inflation in consumer electronics narrows the discount window.
insights.quote: prices on electronics have gone up across the board

insights.claim: SSD prices have skyrocketed, affecting everything from NVMe to microSD storage, and the SanDisk Creator Phone SSD is on sale at $296 (2 TB).
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Storage cost inflation hits consumer devices.

insights.claim: Phones are good enough that best Android phones and iPhones can last up to seven years, shifting spending from handsets to accessories.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Longer handset cycles push growth toward accessories.
insights.quote: the best Android smartphones and iPhones will last up to seven years
insights.locator: Phones are so good these days

insights.claim: Anker's MagGo UFO 3-in-1 Qi2 charger is $63 (30% off) at Anker and the MagGo 3-in-1 is $80, its lowest price during the sale.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Qi2/MagSafe has become the standard accessory ecosystem.

insights.claim: Belkin's 3-in-1 Qi2 stand is WIRED's top pick and matches its lowest-ever price of $63 on Amazon.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Reviewer-backed picks are timed to Prime pricing.

insights.claim: Anker's 25,000-mAh laptop power bank supports up to 165 W and sells for $120 at Best Buy and Anker.
insights.speaker: Les Shu

insights.claim: WIRED recommends Chipolo trackers over Tile or AirTag for working with both Apple and Google devices, at $29-39.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Cross-platform trackers beat ecosystem-locked ones in this review.
insights.quote: WIRED's overall Bluetooth tracker recommendation is not Tile or AirTag, but Chipolo.

insights.claim: The Backbone One controller is $64 (35% off) at Walmart in the USB-C version.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
